note.title: Targeted practice
note.overview: This lesson contains 58 enabled questions. It teaches Targeted practice through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Targeted practice.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Dictation requires exact base spelling and grammar chunks.
Translate complete sentences, not isolated words.
For perfect negatives, check auxiliary and word order.
